description: In-tree volume plugin rbd removed in 1.31 (3 objects). 3 PersistentVolumes or StorageClasses name it, in: cluster-scoped (2), data (1). From 1.31 a pod that names it, or that mounts a claim bound to a PersistentVolume that does, does not start. A StorageClass with provisioner kubernetes.io/rbd has its new claims provisioned by the in-tree plugin, so from 1.31 they are not provisioned. Objects: pv-rbd, pv-unbound, sc-rbd. Fix: redeploy the workload on a volume of the RBD CSI driver (ceph-csi); its CSI migration support was removed with the plugin.

In-tree volume plugin awsElasticBlockStore needs CSI driver ebs.csi.aws.com from 1.27 (2 objects). 1 pod and 1 PersistentVolume or StorageClass name it, in: shop (2). From 1.27 the ebs.csi.aws.com CSI driver serves every operation on these volumes: a cluster without it installed cannot mount them, one with it is fine. A StorageClass with provisioner kubernetes.io/aws-ebs has its new claims provisioned by the in-tree plugin, so from 1.27 by that CSI driver. Objects: pv-ebs, and 1 more. Fix: install the ebs.csi.aws.com CSI driver (aws-ebs-csi-driver) before the upgrade.
